[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] '''Corsa''' was an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] who served aboard the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Valiant (Imperial cruiser)|''Valiant'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In about [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the ''Valiant'', accompanied by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and another Imperial cruiser, ambushed the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in the [[Circarpous system/Legends|Circarpous system]]. Corsa hailed the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] and ordered the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] to stand down and prepare to be boarded. However, the ''Falcon'' successfully evaded capture by the Imperials.
